Class ControllerSerializerDeserializer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.persistence.ControllerSerializerDeserializer
public class ControllerSerializerDeserializer extends Object
Utility class for serializing and deserializing the GameController state. This class handles both full game state saves and lightweight updates (e.g., hourglass turns).

This class is not instantiable.
